faq.question: What is the FASTag annual pass price in 2026?
faq.answer: ₹3,075 for the 2026-27 financial year, up from ₹3,000 when the pass launched in August 2025. It covers one year or 200 trips, whichever ends first, at national highway and national expressway fee plazas.

faq.question: Does the FASTag annual pass work on state highways?
faq.answer: No. It's valid only at fee plazas on National Highways and National Expressways. On state highways, state-run expressways, local tolls and parking lots, your FASTag works as normal and the toll is deducted from your balance.

faq.question: How are trips counted on the annual pass?
faq.answer: At a normal toll plaza, every crossing counts as one trip, so a return journey through one plaza uses two. On closed-tolling expressways, where toll depends on distance, one entry and exit together counts as a single trip.

faq.question: Do I need to do KYV for my FASTag in 2026?
faq.answer: Not for a car, in most cases. NHAI stopped routine KYV for cars on new FASTags from 1 February 2026, and existing car tags need it only if there's a complaint, such as a loose tag or misuse. New tags are verified against VAHAN before activation.

faq.question: What happens if I cross a toll without a working FASTag?
faq.answer: At national highway plazas, you pay 1.25 times the toll if you pay by UPI, or twice the toll in cash. This rule has applied since 15 November 2025.
